test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd letter-cluster is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

Option 1) RXU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88fc1d43a76b6f0e5c4e45d7d91a99d6fe6f4921067ac4698868ba5917fd3d3b.png] 

Option 2) IOL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11bf0d660215df77c57a88889ec4a4a18c0fa7d20932a35a696c6540e27922a8.png] 

Option 3) MSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac99f2035743eded5481f1cb73e3fb8119c66746220f02fce5efe4e54b8f5e9a.png] 

Option 4) FLI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e05acca2cec18d7da3539f63d4ebdf8fc87c8588db56c088a88d6381d58a2d24.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'MSO' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
